name: smwmusic-kirby-canvas-curse-medal-swap
title: Kirby: Canvas Curse - Medal Swap
description:
The energectic remix of the Kirby 64 Enemy Card Index theme.
Not gonna lie, from all of the other "Entrance" themes, this one was the most difficult to port, both in terms to put everything into 8 channels, and optimize all of the samples. Though, it was really worth the effort put on it.
